ThornyTrail_Text_Npc0.en: NIDORINO is nasty when it feels\ncornered.
ThornyTrail_Text_Npc0.fr: NIDORINO est méchant quand il se\nsent acculé.

ThornyTrail_Text_Npc1.en: Moon stone, moon stone... I have\nnone.
ThornyTrail_Text_Npc1.fr: Pierre lune, pierre lune… Je n'en\nai pas.

ThornyTrail_Text_Quest0_Ask.en: My buddy fainted! A REVIVE, and I\ngive a POISON BARB.
ThornyTrail_Text_Quest0_Ask.fr: Mon pote est K.O. ! Un RAPPEL, et\nje te donne un CROC VENIN.

ThornyTrail_Text_Quest0_Done.en: He is up! Take this POISON BARB.
ThornyTrail_Text_Quest0_Done.fr: Il est debout ! Prends ce CROC\nVENIN.

ThornyTrail_Text_Quest0_NoRoomT.en: Your BAG is full. Make room, then\ncome back.
ThornyTrail_Text_Quest0_NoRoomT.fr: Ton SAC est plein. Fais de la\nplace, puis reviens.

ThornyTrail_Text_ReturnAsk.en: Ready to go back to the dock?

ThornyTrail_Text_Stay.en: Take your time. The tide can wait.
ThornyTrail_Text_Stay.fr: Prends ton temps. La marée peut\nattendre.

ThornyTrail_Text_TopazeFindFull.en: Something shines here, but your BAG\nis full.
ThornyTrail_Text_TopazeFindFull.fr: Quelque chose brille ici, mais ton\nSAC est plein.
